personality.traits: If someone is in trouble, I'm always ready to lend help.
personality.ideals: Freedom. Chains are meant to be broken, as are those who would forge them.
personality.bonds: I have a family, but I have no idea where they are. I hope to find them one day.
personality.flaws: I'm convinced of the significance of my destiny, and blind to my shortcomings.

backstory: After years as a sailor, Andry heard the call to adventure. Armed with fighter training and hard-won wisdom, the journey begins.
